## 311 rodent complaints, 2018 - 2026

The data come from the NYC Open Data API, read with `GET()`, so anyone can rerun this file. The API returns only 1,000 rows by default, so we raise `$limit` and download one year at a time. 311 is split into two datasets: `76ig-c548` covers 2010-2019 and `erm2-nwe9` covers 2020 to present. We keep every complaint with complaint type "Rodent" and choose the descriptor ("Rat Sighting") later, so no category is lost.

### Function to download dataset

```{r download_function}
get_rodent_year = function(dataset_id, yr) {

  Sys.sleep(5)

  GET(
    paste0("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/", dataset_id, ".csv"),
    query = list(
      "$select" = "unique_key, created_date, descriptor, community_board, borough, location_type, latitude, longitude",
      "$where" = paste0(
        "complaint_type = 'Rodent' AND created_date >= '", yr,
        "-01-01T00:00:00' AND created_date < '", yr + 1, "-01-01T00:00:00'"
      ),
      "$limit" = "300000"
    )
  ) |>
    content("text") |>
    read_csv(col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
}
```

### Data import 

```{r download_data}
if (!file.exists("data/rodent_311.csv")) {

  dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

  rodent_2018_2019 =
    map(2018:2019, \(yr) get_rodent_year("76ig-c548", yr)) |>
    bind_rows()

  rodent_2020_2026 =
    map(2020:2026, \(yr) get_rodent_year("erm2-nwe9", yr)) |>
    bind_rows()

  rodent_raw = bind_rows(rodent_2018_2019, rodent_2020_2026)

  write_csv(rodent_raw, "data/rodent_311.csv")
}
```


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
nyc_311_2020 = 
  read_csv("data/nyc_311_2020.csv") |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(
    unique_key,
    created_date,
    problem_formerly_complaint_type, 
    problem_detail_formerly_descriptor, 
    location_type,
    incident_address,
    borough, 
    latitude,
    longitude
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    created_date = as.Date(lubridate::mdy_hms(created_date))
  )

# General view of data
view(nyc_311_2020)

#Summary based on types of 311 calls
descriptor_summary = 
  nyc_311_2020 |> 
   mutate(
    year = lubridate::year(created_date),
    complaint = problem_detail_formerly_descriptor
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2020,
    year <= 2026
  ) |>
  group_by(year, complaint) |>
  summarize(
    n = n_distinct(unique_key),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(year)

#tidy readable table
descriptor_summary|>  
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = complaint,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |> 
  knitr::kable()

#plots
descriptor_plot = 
  descriptor_summary |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, color = complaint)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
descriptor_plot
```
